visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with a long side braid and a white cardigan stands in a hallway outside a door. She holds a white flower-shaped light stick and speaks excitedly to the camera, gesturing with her hands. The hallway is dimly lit with dark wood paneling and a decorative plaque on the door. (2) She opens the door and walks into a spacious, modern private box. The room features a long table with snacks, a black ceiling with rhythmic light strips, and red lounge chairs. She smiles and shows off the interior. (3) She moves to the edge of the box, which overlooks a massive indoor stadium. The arena is filled with a sea of yellow light sticks. She gestures towards the stage where a large screen is visible. (4) The scene shifts to the concert performance. A male performer (G-Dragon) in a sparkling suit and a hat sings and dances on a high-tech stage with vibrant pink and red laser lighting. Backup dancers accompany him. (5) Closer shots of the performer show him singing into a microphone and interacting with the crowd. The background screens display abstract visuals and his own image.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy female Mandarin speech opens the audio, accompanied by an upbeat electronic music bed. Her voice is excited and clear. (2) A sharp transition occurs as the scene moves into the box; a loud 'Wow' vocalization overlaps with swelling synthesizer sounds. (3) The audio shifts to a live concert environment. Thumping bass kicks and bright electronic textures dominate. (4) Male Korean vocals (G-Dragon) begin singing a rhythmic pop song. The audio captures the wide-bandwidth reverberation of a stadium. (5) Intense crowd cheering and screaming rise during high-energy performance moments, blending with the percussive synth-driven music. (6) The song changes to a more melodic ballad-style vocal, followed by a high-pitched shout from the performer saying 'I love you' in Mandarin.
